profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Microsoft | ex-Spotify
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms at Microsoft and Spotify.

Currently working on Xbox Advertising, designing and building AdTech infrastructure and real-time ad decisioning platforms that power advertising across Xbox surfaces and King games, including Candy Crush Saga.

Experienced in building DSP systems, ad serving infrastructure, campaign delivery platforms, and data pipelines processing billions of ad bid requests and large-scale impression data.

Previously at Spotify, where I developed backend services and data platforms supporting Spotify Wrapped, experimentation systems, and large-scale marketing infrastructure.

Interested in solving problems in AdTech, distributed systems, real-time platforms, and large-scale backend infrastructure.

company.name: Xbox Media Solutions (Formerly Activision Blizzard Media)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Xbox
positions.description:
Working on the Xbox Advertising platform, building real-time AdTech infrastructure and ad decisioning systems powering advertising across Xbox surfaces and King games including Candy Crush Saga.

Key contributions:
• Leading architecture and development of real-time ad decisioning services powering campaign delivery and advertiser reporting.
• Building Demand-Side Platform (DSP) services responsible for campaign selection and ad delivery using user targeting and bidding pipelines.
• Designed inventory allocation algorithms using supply forecasting and user scarcity signals to optimize campaign delivery.
• Developed campaign pacing systems ensuring campaigns remain aligned with advertiser budgets and delivery goals.
• Designed scalable data architecture using PostgreSQL, Redis, Bigtable, and Elasticsearch to support large-scale ad serving and impression tracking.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on backend platforms and data infrastructure powering several consumer-facing Spotify features and marketing systems used by millions of users worldwide. Contributed to scalable backend services, experimentation platforms, and integrations that supported new product experiences and partner ecosystems.

Key contributions:
• Architected backend services and data pipelines powering user listening insights and analytics, enabling new product experiences built on listening behavior.
• Developed backend systems supporting Spotify Wrapped, enabling large-scale generation and sharing of personalized listening stories across external platforms.
• Led integration of Spotify streaming APIs with external DJ platforms, enabling DJs to access Spotify catalogs within professional DJ software and expanding platform reach.
• Built event-driven marketing infrastructure using Pub/Sub, enabling automated push notifications and social marketing campaigns.
• Led A/B experimentation initiatives across markets to evaluate new product features and improve user engagement and retention.
• Explored Web3-based fan engagement initiatives, enabling artists to showcase NFTs and create exclusive fan experiences.

Technologies:
Java · Python · GCP · Pub/Sub · Microservices · Data Pipelines · Experimentation Platforms · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented Ansible roles for Kafka and Zookeeper to manage and deploy Kafka cluster
•	Configured, enabled and managed the Kafka security features like encryption, authentication and authorization via SSL/SASL
•	Worked with Kafka Streams to generated more meaningful streams for downstream processes
•	Worked with numerous Spring-based micro-services interacting either via REST or messaging broker
•	Working with third-party vendor to gather and integration financial data, to be used for the underwriting
•	Auto deployment of services via Ansible playbooks
Introduced and implemented FileBeats to push all the application logs to elastic search via LogStash and connect them using Spring Sleuth.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for designing user interfaces, building scalable architectures, and leveraging the latest technologies and tools to build a SaaS recruiting application. Areas I actively work on includes Integration with external vendors and system, iForms, SDK, REST API and Mule ESB
Lead the adoption of MuleESB for improving our integration technologies.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Primary Web Developer at office with responsibilities involving design, development and maintenance of office websites which includes club management system and budget management system used for managing the annual budget.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Analyzed the sentiment of social media to help organizations position their marketing campaigns. Primary responsibilities involved design and development of sentiment algorithms and maintaining the servers.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: Developed a website which brought to the users the news in summarized form. Was responsible for the back-end as well as front-end development along with server administration

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Developed a system for the post office agents to maintain a well-organized record of clients. It also included a notification system that automatically notified the clients through text message about the deadlines.

projects.title: Trending Topics using Twitter
projects.description:
• Designed and Implemented a pipeline to find trending topics in Twitter
• Used Twitter Streaming API and Storm to process the realtime tweets, and store data through Cassandra

projects.title: CombiBox
projects.description: - Built a virtual layer that enables user to store files across different Cloud storage services like Dropbox, Google Drive, Box etc.
